fixed_training.head: 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm and dropout
fixed_training.call_weighting: global class-balanced weights computed once from all calls in the current training role

shared_training.inner: one trajectory records both selection metrics at every epoch
shared_training.outer: one trajectory runs to max(E_call,E_animal) and emits both checkpoint predictions
shared_training.early_stop: stop only after both selection metrics have failed to improve for eight consecutive epochs

primary_confirmation_rule.supporting_evidence: at least one of balanced accuracy, QWK, plain accuracy, worst-repeat macro F1, repeat dispersion, or paired bootstrap supports C1
primary_confirmation_rule.decision_when_met: adopt animal-level CE checkpoint selection as part of the tuned frozen-AST reference
primary_confirmation_rule.decision_when_positive_but_not_met: retain mixed evidence and return the reference decision to the team
primary_confirmation_rule.decision_when_nonpositive: retain call-level CE selection and record seed-17 as exploratory
